topics.title: Meaning of and reasons for international business

concepts.learning_objective: Define international business and explain why it is broader than international trade.
Explain how unequal resources and productivity lead nations to specialise and trade.
Distinguish between domestic and international business on the bases given in the chapter.
Explain how the use of different currencies and fluctuating exchange rates complicate international business.
Distinguish between merchandise (visible) trade and service (invisible) trade with examples.
Distinguish between foreign direct investment and portfolio investment.
Identify the benefits that international business offers to nations.
Identify the benefits that international business offers to business firms.
Distinguish direct from indirect exporting and state the advantages and limitations of exporting.
Explain contract manufacturing, its forms, advantages and limitations.

topics.title: Licensing, franchising, joint ventures and wholly owned subsidiaries

concepts.learning_objective: Explain licensing and franchising and distinguish between the two.
Explain the ways of forming a joint venture and its advantages and limitations.
Explain wholly owned subsidiaries and evaluate their suitability for a firm.
Arrange and explain the steps involved in a typical export transaction.
Identify the purpose of the main documents used in an export transaction.
Explain the steps involved in a typical import transaction into India.
Identify the purpose of the main documents used in an import transaction.
